# louppe media culler

> a free, open-source, local, keyboard-first photo, video, and audio culler for macOS. the app itself is named Louppe.

review in Gallery or Grid with decisions, stars, color labels, filters and selection. analyze exact duplicates, likely similar photos and capture bursts locally. group RAW+JPEG pairs, inspect at 100%, and play video or audio. clean up to macOS Trash, organize folders, then copy or move your keepers. route copies to multiple folders and use XMP sidecars for portable metadata.

- [website](https://louppe.eu/): product overview, features, and download
- [download](https://github.com/alexander-markin-meow/louppe-media-culler/releases): macOS releases
- [source code](https://github.com/alexander-markin-meow/louppe-media-culler): application source
- [author](https://alex-markin.com/): alex markin

The website presents Gallery, Grid and a captioned 25-second Demo in one media viewer. A written walkthrough is available with the Demo. Created by artist Alex Markin.

- [blog](https://louppe.eu/blog/): notes on making Louppe and new releases, by Alex Markin
